property_summary: For any actor and any pair of hashes, after a successful lockInGuess the same actor's second lockInGuess must revert (their target block is recorded, so the require(guesses.block == 0) guard blocks re-locking); the mutant never records the block, so the second lock succeeds and the rule is broken.
change_summary: Delete the statement that sets guesses[msg.sender].block, so the target block is never recorded.
